title: Direct N-body Simulator
shortDescription:
A gravitational direct N-body simulator, constrained to CPU processing.
Taking advantage of SIMD, OpenMP multi-threading, and algorithmic optimisations, to improve performance.

title: CV Classification
shortDescription: Astronomical photometry and the detection of superhump periodicities in Cataclysmic Variable stars.

title: SIMBAD Object Finder
shortDescription: An interactive astronomical object filtering tool built using Pluto.jl. Built to aid first-year telescope observations.
